fields.name: order
fields.documentation: Reports this node's stable traversal order in the stored layout.

fields.name: location
fields.documentation: Reports this node's position relative to its parent.

fields.name: size
fields.documentation: Reports this node's outer width and height.

fields.name: scrollableOverflowRect
fields.documentation: Reports the scrollable overflow rectangle relative to this node's scroll origin; right and bottom are the reachable content extents, while negative left and top values represent unreachable start-side overflow.

fields.name: scrollbarSize
fields.documentation: Reports the width and height reserved for scrollbars.

fields.name: border
fields.documentation: Reports this node's resolved border widths.

fields.name: padding
fields.documentation: Reports this node's resolved padding widths.
